raw_retention.status: Local transient run artifacts; no durable hosted artifact receipt is asserted
raw_retention.policy: Bulky logs, native receipts, trees, custody and journals are not committed. Essential named failure excerpts and compact transaction details are retained here. Reproduce with the committed runner; hashes alone are not independent raw proof.
raw_retention.ci: Workflow is configured for bounded artifacts; this index does not assert any future hosted run or retention.

process_notes: There are 14 independent guard groups and 15 negative test invocations. The live-source group also runs both native migration and same-module rollover. The separate existing vault_live runner exercises that same live-source guard again; it is not a fifteenth independent guard.
An earlier incomplete control run hit an unrelated undefined-hidden-symbol linker failure; its partial three red receipts are excluded from the completed set here.

The initial control baseline preceded import ordering and clock C formatting. All negative controls and that runner's restored baseline used the archived pre-Python-format script hashes. Rust production sources are unchanged. A later mandatory ruff format gate changed 7 scripts with identical ASTs, followed by a final complete normal two-rotation smoke; no earlier control receipt is relabeled as having executed the later bytes.

The Attach entry-point control uses a private limit-zero binary in both its green and red phases; only the Attach call is removed for red and Promote remains guarded. The production 31/32 unit is separate. No 33 or 64 native rotations are claimed.
command_encoding: command_ref selects an exact argument array; replace the single {{output}} token with command_parameters.output. Top-level runner commands are stored verbatim.
